source: The diagnosis was right shoulder and back injuries.

manifestations.description: numbness on right shoulder radiated to her neck
difficulty in prolonged walking and standing; could not walk fast
difficulty in changing position in bed and getting up from bed
difficulty in holding pen or pencil to write
redness and tenderness and limitation on motion of her shoulder and back
bruise over the lower back and the right upper back, both with tenderness
diminished power over right leg due to back pain
required a frame / walking stick for walking support
Waddell signs observed (suggesting non-organic origin / symptom exaggeration)
50% sensation deficit over her right upper and lower limbs (physiotherapy assessment)
limitation of right shoulder forward flexion to 140 degrees and limited 'hand behind back' test at T12 level

treatments_received.treatment: attendance at Accident & Emergency Department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital
source: DFB attended the Accident and Emergency Department (A&E) of the Queen Elizabeth Hospital ("QEH") on 23 June 2010 for further treatment
She was hospitalized from 26 to 30 June 2010
She also attended the Physiotherapy Department of QEH for two sessions.
She was given Interferential Therapy and Hot Pack to relieve back and neck symptoms. Back and neck exercises were prescribed with back and neck care advice.
She was able to walk with a frame in ward.
Walking exercises and walking stick prescription were given to her.

losses.description: Difficulties in prolonged walking and standing; could not walk fast; required walking frame / walking stick for support.
